messages:
kevin.l: follow-up from today's sync: we need a clearer approach for partial artifact delivery over unreliable proxies. Proposal: split bundles into content-addressed shards with manifest-level application markers. Operator can verify integrity per-shard and apply progressively. That reduces time-to-activation for large model bundles.

maria.k: important for large models. but how do we ensure atomic activation semantics across shard-by-shard apply? we still need a post-apply marker that proves full activation.

kevin.l: plan: each shard gets a readiness-proof (HMAC over shard and manifest_seq). operator stages shards into per-shard directories and only flips the activation pointer when all presence + proofs verified. If partial, operator keeps a staged state and can continue later.

sam.ops: shard verification: streaming hash verify while downloading. artifact transport via pull-proxy with mTLS. if a shard fails checksum, operator requests re-fetch of that shard only. logs of per-shard status go to local ledger.

lina.operator: UX: show per-shard progress in operatorctl status. For offline sites we should support an opt-in progressive-activation mode where critical smaller shards (runtime + weights small) are prioritized and large optional shards deferred. Admin sets activation policy per-customer.

maria.k: threat model: shard replay and mix-and-match attacks. We should bind manifest_seq + bundle_id to each shard and include a shard index and total in the readiness-proof. Also require a manifest root signature that covers all shard descriptors.

kevin.l: exactly. manifest root = signed Merkle root over shard descriptors. operator verifies root signature first, then per-shard readiness proofs derived from the root.

sam.ops: retention: staged shards consume disk. operator should garbage collect old staged shards once new activation confirmed. GC policy default keep last two activations. Also need disk low-space heuristics.

lina.operator: commands idea:
  operatorctl fetch-shard --bundle bundle-... --shard 3 --out /var/lib/operator/stage/shard-3.tgz
  operatorctl activate --bundle bundle-... --mode progressive
  operatorctl status shows shards downloaded, verified, applied

maria.k: add consistency checks: operator should validate that staged shards were downloaded from same pull-proxy (via server cert KID) to avoid cross-proxy substitution.

kevin.l: edge case: operator rejoin after long offline period; manifests may have been compacted. operator needs manifest cache with last N manifests and ability to reject out-of-window shards. also support manifest rebase by control-plane with note of compaction mapping.

sam.ops: implement journaling: per-shard download record + verify proof + stage timestamp. upload ledger later. Also need to throttle concurrent shard downloads to not blow bandwidth.

lina.operator: admin policy UI: progressive activation toggles, prioritized shards list, provisional flag for offline approvals, and retention settings. Keep CLIs simple for field use.

kevin.l: summary: shardable bundles + manifest root signature + per-shard readiness proofs + progressive activation + GC policy. Ill add this as a subsection in the ongoing RFC. Maria please add forensic checks for cross-proxy substitution; Sam sketch GC heuristics; Lina write CLI UX.

security-bot: flagged potential CVE surface for provisional activation: CVE-XXXX-2026 (discussion ticket created)

kevin.l: nice. will follow-up on CVE thread too.
